priorityList: Ensure Hunter's Mark is active on the target from you or another Hunter in the group!
Cast all of your Barbed Shots.
Proceed with your normal Rotation according to the priority list below.
Trinket Usage Stat-granting on-use Trinkets should be used right before Bestial Wrath.

Cast Kill Command on cooldown with Nature's Ally up. If Bestial Wrath is coming up within a few seconds, hold a Kill Command charge for it. You may ignore Nature's Ally only if Howl of the Pack Leader is ready (it will glow when this is the case).
Cast Cobra Shot as a filler.
Cast Kill Command on cooldown with Nature's Ally up. If Bestial Wrath is coming up within a few seconds, hold a Kill Command charge for it.
Cast Barbed Shot during Bestial Wrath.
Cast Barbed Shot as a filler.
Cast Cobra Shot as a filler when you can do absolutely nothing else.
Cast Cobra Shot if Wild Thrash is more than ~1.25 seconds away. Otherwise, simply spam Wild Thrash in anticipation of it coming off cooldown.
Continue with your normal rotation. Wailing Arrow when you have no more Barbeds or Kill Commands.
Cast Wailing Arrow if Bestial Wrath is about to end.
--- WoWhead Opener (GENERIC - not filtered by hero spec) ---
Before pull, apply Hunter's Mark on your priority target.
Pre-cast Algeth'ar Puzzle Box two seconds before the pull.
As pull starts, cast Barbed Shot.
Use your potion, racials that boost your stats and trinkets other than Algeth'ar Puzzle Box.
Cast Bestial Wrath. Make sure your pet is attacking your target by now!
Proceed with the rest of your rotation like normal.
